issue:
# Issue #2: Book search is case-sensitive

Searching the catalog for `dune` returns nothing, but `Dune` finds it. Same
for authors: `le guin` returns 0 results. Users don't type exact
capitalisation. Search should ignore case for both title and author.
diff:
diff --git a/app/catalog.py b/app/catalog.py
index 4413406..7b6b12f 100644
--- a/app/catalog.py
+++ b/app/catalog.py
@@ -3,8 +3,13 @@ from app.store import Store
 
 
 def search_books(books: list[Book], query: str) -> list[Book]:
-    """Books whose title or author contains the query."""
-    return [b for b in books if query in b.title or query in b.author]
+    """Books whose title or author contains the query (case-insensitive)."""
+    needle = query.casefold()
+    return [
+        b
+        for b in books
+        if needle in b.title.casefold() or needle in b.author.casefold()
+    ]
 
 
 def paginate(books: list[Book], limit: int, offset: int) -> list[Book]:
